# TripSheet

TripSheet is a zero-backend, client-side web utility for converting chaotic travel booking text into a clean chronological timeline. 

## Technical Details
- Built with React, Vite, Tailwind v4
- Local storage via IndexedDB (Dexie.js)
- State management via Zustand
- Routing via Wouter
- Styling via Tailwind CSS and GSAP
- Export engine via html-to-image
- Stateless sharing via lz-string URL hashes

## Architecture Philosophy
- Zero Backend: No user accounts, no databases, no server-side APIs. Runs entirely in the browser to ensure $0 operational cost and maximum privacy.
- Instant Value: Renders timelines immediately.
- Mobile-First: Interfaces are designed for phones first, scaling up to cinematic desktop layouts.
